motivation: Seed-8600 capability ladder (capability_benchmark_analysis_20260830): outside the envelope the arms order exactly by frontier exposure (fixed >= lucid_rg >= mixture >= off). The one untested lever is training SUPPORT past lambda=1. fixed_150 trains fixed DR at 1.5x with physical clamps and a delay buffer sized for 60 ms.

design.allow_extrapolation: fixed-mode only; controller config stays in [0,1]
design.training_clamps: clamp_physical after every extrapolated apply; report in receipt

evaluation.comparator_topup: campaign arms at lat_60ms only, eval-only, same panel

design.queue_position: fourth: campaign -> lucid_plr_signal -> margin arm -> this

hypotheses.H_X1_support: fixed_150 success exceeds fixed by >= 3 pts averaged over phys_150/phys_175/phys_200, in >= 2/3 seeds (per-seed paired cells)
hypotheses.H_X2_no_nominal_price: fixed_150 in-envelope AUC (phys_000..phys_100) within 1 pt of fixed per seed
hypotheses.H_X3_latency_frontier: fixed_150 >= fixed + 5 pts at lat_60ms in >= 2/3 seeds; lat_50ms reported both ways (inside fixed_150's trained range, outside fixed's)
hypotheses.H_X4_manipulation_check: receipts record physical_clamp on friction and realized actuator delay reaching ~12 steps; if absent, the arm did not train the extension and every cell is void, reported as an implementation failure

decision_rule: H_X1 pass -> support extension is the causal capability lever; curricula must extend support to matter on this task; mix_150 (stratified variant) becomes the follow-up only if H_X2 fails (a nominal price appears that a mixture could avoid). H_X1 fail while H_X2 holds -> capability saturates at the lambda=1 envelope; the curriculum question on this testbed shifts from capability to efficiency, and that is what gets written.
